missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Церковь' is a feminine soft-sign noun in the nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Старая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'в центре' gives the location.

missions.phrase: В воскресенье мы идём в церковь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of destination. 'Церковь' is a third-declension noun whose accusative matches the nominative; after 'в' it marks motion toward the place. 'В воскресенье' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Церкви' is the genitive after 'нет', stating no church is nearby. 'Старой' agrees in the feminine genitive of the third declension.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Церкви' takes the dative after 'к' to show where the path leads. 'Ведёт' expresses the route, a common motion pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В церкви' uses the prepositional form 'церкви' after 'в' to mean inside the church. 'Тихо' describes how the people pray.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Церковь' is the accusative object of 'фотографируют', identical to the nominative form. 'Красивую' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Церковью' takes the instrumental after 'перед', meaning in front of the church. 'Собралась' shows the crowd gathering there.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Церквей' is the genitive plural required by 'много', with the characteristic '-ей' ending. 'В этом городе' sets the place.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Церкви' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' and 'древние' agree in the plural, and 'очень' intensifies the description.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Церкви' takes the genitive after 'около', meaning near the church. 'Часто' adds frequency to the strolling.
